name: layerdesk
description: Open a PSD, move its layers, save it back. Offline browser layer editor with a Live2D / Spine rigging check · 離線瀏覽器 PSD 圖層編輯器

paragraphs: layerdesk is an offline-first layer editor for PSD files that runs entirely in the browser. Drag in a PSD to see every layer, then move, scale, rotate, hide, reorder and group them, and save the result as a PSD again or export PNG images. A check panel points out layers that tend to break when the file is imported into Live2D Cubism or Spine.
Status: first release. The design is in docs/spec.md.

Small fixes to a layered artwork, such as nudging an arm, renaming parts or hiding a sketch layer, usually mean opening a large desktop image editor or uploading the file to an online service. layerdesk opens the PSD in a browser tab, lets you rearrange the layers and saves it back. Your files stay on your machine.
features: Move layers by dragging, and scale or rotate them with transform handles
Show and hide layers, change opacity and blend mode, rename, reorder, group and ungroup
Undo and redo for every edit
Save as PSD, export the composite as PNG, or export every layer as PNG in a ZIP
